post.summary: Add a recipe's ingredients to a list
post.description: Scales the amounts to `servings` (the recipe's own servings by default) and merges identical ingredients: the same name with the same unit adds up (200 g + 100 g flour is 300 g). Different units stay on separate lines, and an ingredient without an amount is added without one. Ingredients on the pantry list of the list's space (your own, or the household's) are left out and returned in `skipped`. You need to be able to see the recipe.

200.description: The list with the ingredients added

skipped.description: Names of the ingredients that were left out because they are on the pantry list

404.description: The list or the recipe doesn't exist, or you can't see it

post.summary: Fill days automatically from your saved recipes
post.description: Plain code, not AI: the same wishes give the same plan, whichever AI provider (or none) the server uses. Wishes: `caloriesPerDay`, `diet` (a tag) and `maxMinutes`. `days` lists the days to fill; a day can be skipped (`skip`), have meals skipped (`skipSlots`) or its own `servings`. By default only empty slots are filled; `overwrite` replaces planned meals. Recipes that lack the data a wish needs (a calorie estimate, a cooking time) are skipped, never guessed. When nothing matches, the slot stays empty and is listed in `unfilled`. Calories are estimates.

200.description: The plan, and the slots that stayed empty

404.description: The plan doesn't exist, or you can't see it

post.summary: Add the plan's ingredients to a shopping list
post.description: Nothing is added to a list unless you call this. Every meal's ingredients are scaled to its servings and merged into the list like a recipe is. Use `from` and `to` to take only some days.
